==Polish==

===Etymology===
{{etymon|pl|id=speak|:inh|zlw-opl:powiedzieć|tree=+|text=+}} {{surf|pl|po-|wiedzieć}}.

===Pronunciation===
{{pl-pr|a=Pl-powiedzieć.ogg|mp=#}}

===Verb===
{{pl-verb|pf|impf=mówić}}

# {{lb|pl|transitive}} to [[speak]], to [[talk]] {{gl|to use one's voice to communicate}} {{+obj|pl|:do(gen)/dat<(to) whom> + :o(loc)<about what>}}
#: {{syn|pl|rzec}}
#: {{uxi|pl|Dlaczego mi nie '''powiedziałeś'''?|Why didn't you '''tell''' me?}}
#: {{uxi|pl|Możesz mi '''powiedzieć''', gdzie jest najbliższy przystanek autobusowy?|Can you '''tell''' me where the nearest bus stop is?}}
#: {{uxi|pl|Ja tego nie '''powiedziałem'''.|I didn't '''say''' that.}}
#: {{uxi|pl|'''Powiedział''', że będzie tutaj jutro.|He '''said''' he would be here tomorrow.}}
# {{lb|pl|transitive}} to [[call]], to [[name]] {{gl|to speak using particular pronouns}} {{+obj|pl|:do(gen)/dat<whom> + :per(nom)/:na(nom)/nom<by what name>}}
#: {{coi|pl|'''powiedzieć''' na ty|to '''use''' [[T-form]]s with each other}}
# {{lb|pl|transitive}} to [[say]]; to [[go]], to [[tell]] about {{gl|to contain or communicate specific information on a topic}} {{+obj|pl|dat<to whom> + :o(loc)<about what>}}
# {{lb|pl|transitive}} to [[say]], to [[tell]] {{gl|to communicate by non-verbal means}}
# {{lb|pl|transitive}} to [[tell]] {{gl|to suggest a course of action}} {{+obj|pl|dat}}
#: {{coi|pl|Serce '''powiedziało''' mi...|My heart '''told''' me...}}
